subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: What permanent rule should distinguish an intentional full Skill Workshop rewrite from an unrelated proposal that must not auto-apply?
rationale: The PR changes the automatic-approval contract while its current any-line-overlap rule is demonstrably too weak; choosing a continuity threshold or explicit replacement signal requires operator workflow intent.

options.title: Require substantial continuity
options.body: Auto-apply only when meaningful existing body content is retained, and require explicit approval for low-continuity replacements.

options.title: Add explicit replacement intent
options.body: Keep ordinary updates automatic but require a typed replace mode or equivalent explicit signal for complete rewrites.

options.title: Keep unconditional auto
options.body: Reject only malformed or empty bodies and accept that semantically unrelated valid skill-shaped content can auto-apply.

recommendation.title: Require substantial continuity
recommendation.body: Auto-apply only when meaningful existing body content is retained, and require explicit approval for low-continuity replacements.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current automatic lifecycle approval behavior that this decision would narrow.
